transcript.text: roomba e5 wont charge properly, sometimes it does sometimes it doesnt

Switch it off and unplug it (or take the battery off) first. Intermittent charging on a Roomba E5 is most commonly caused by dirty charging contacts rather than a major internal fault. Dust and debris can build up on the metal pads on the bottom of the robot and inside the dock, preventing a good electrical connection. 1. Wipe the gold charging contacts on the bottom of your Roomba with a dry cloth to remove any dust or film.
2. Check the contacts inside the charging dock in the same way.
3. Does it show a solid amber light (charging) or green (fully charged), or do the lights flash? Also, is the power adapter for the dock plugged securely into both the wall and the dock?

Dock contacts were dull with a greasy grey film, and there was lots of hair round the ones on the robot. I wiped them and it's charged every night for 4 days now, no error. Base power light comes on when it docks. Before that the ring was red with the app saying Charging error 5. No heat, smell or swelling.

That is excellent news. It sounds like the greasy film and hair were most likely blocking the connection, causing that Charging Error 5. Since it has charged reliably for four days with no errors, the issue is resolved. To stop this from happening again, I would suggest giving those contacts a quick wipe with a dry cloth once every month or so to keep them clear of dust and debris before they build up into a film.
